entry.title: New: Resolution 256 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Postponed
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO HAWAI‘I HI-DIVING FRIENDS FOR A NEW THREE-METER DIVING STAND AND BOARD FOR THE CHARLES “SPARKY” KAWAMOTO SWIM STADIUM

Transfers $6,000 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 2)

Latest action: Council: Postponed Res. 256-25 to the Call of the Chair - 08/06/25; never taken up again.
